ValidationRule.description: (BRME-6823) Ensures Notes are populated when Strategic Location review status is pending addition or pending removal.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: !$Setup.Bypass_Automation_Setting__c.IM_Strategic_Location_Validation__c && AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Review_Status__c, "Pending Addition"), ISPICKVAL(Review_Status__c, "Pending Removal") ), ISBLANK(Notes__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Notes are required when Review Status is Pending Addition or Pending Removal.
